reason: Our painter has done this house for years and my parents know him and trust him in the house while I am in Dubai. I will not hand the job to a crew they have never met because of one advert, and ₹78,000 is not small money for us.
objection: It says the work is guaranteed against bubbling and peeling but not for how long or what happens if it does. With me abroad and my parents alone, I need to know who comes back to fix it and at whose cost.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee with a clear term, say five years, that covers redoing the affected walls at no cost, plus a price that is not much above what our own painter quotes.
